name: Smart Affiliate Link Cloaker
tagline: The Modern Link Routing, Geolocation, and Automated Compliance Engine (100% Feature Complete)
description: Transform ugly referral links into branded short links while automating FTC legal disclosures, dynamic geo-targeting, DOM-safe keyword auto-linking, and broken link monitoring without third-party SaaS fees.

keyFeatures.title: Custom Cloaked Slug Architecture
keyFeatures.description: Convert long referral URLs into clean links using custom prefixes such as /go/, /recommends/, or /deal/.

keyFeatures.title: High-Speed HTTP Status Handling
keyFeatures.description: Full support for native 301 permanent, 302 temporary, and 307 dynamic redirections with cache-control headers.

keyFeatures.title: Automatic SEO Attribute Enforcement
keyFeatures.description: Automatically append rel="nofollow sponsored" and rel="noopener noreferrer" across all cloaked links.

keyFeatures.title: Dynamic FTC Auto-Disclosure Banner
keyFeatures.description: Automatically identifies cloaked URLs inside content and inserts compliant legal disclosures with 4 visual CSS styles.

keyFeatures.title: Dynamic Geolocation Routing
keyFeatures.description: Automatically routes traffic to country-specific merchant storefronts based on real-time visitor IP geolocation.

keyFeatures.title: A/B Split Testing & Traffic Rotation
keyFeatures.description: Distribute inbound clicks across multiple target URLs with percentage weights to identify top-converting vendor landing pages.

keyFeatures.title: Dynamic UTM Forwarding
keyFeatures.description: Intercepts inbound UTM query parameters and automatically attaches them to the destination link.

keyFeatures.title: Automated Deal Expiration & Fallbacks
keyFeatures.description: Establish calendar expiration dates or click thresholds that route visitors to evergreen fallback deals instead of dead 404 pages.

keyFeatures.title: DOM-Safe Keyword Auto-Linker
keyFeatures.description: Automatically transforms target keywords in existing posts into cloaked links without breaking headings, existing hyperlinks, or code blocks.

keyFeatures.title: Target URL Health & Broken Link Scanner
keyFeatures.description: Daily background pings that mark broken links and email alerts when affiliate destination links go offline or change.

features: Target URL Health & Broken Link Monitor

documentationSections.title: Phase 1: Installation
documentationSections.content: Uploading smart-affiliate-link-cloaker.zip in WordPress Admin Dashboard.
steps: Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
Select smart-affiliate-link-cloaker.zip and click Install Now.
Click Activate Plugin to finalize installation.

documentationSections.title: Phase 2: Creating First Link
documentationSections.content: Creating clean, branded referral URLs with 301, 302, or 307 redirect status codes.
steps: Go to SALC Links > Add New Link.
Enter Title, Cloaked Slug, and Destination URL.
Publish and share your clean short link!

documentationSections.title: Phase 3: Setting up Auto-Linker [PRO]
documentationSections.content: Automating keyword replacement across all historic posts and pages.
steps: Go to SALC Links > Settings > Auto-Linker [PRO].
Add target keyword and select associated cloaked link.
Save settings to convert keywords automatically!

documentationSections.title: Phase 4: FTC Compliance
documentationSections.content: Rendering customizable legal disclosure banners across pages containing cloaked links.
steps: Select banner visual style (Default, Alert, Minimal, Subtle).
Choose placement (Top of Content recommended).
Save settings to render compliance disclosures automatically.

name: ShelfMaster
tagline: Next-Gen Library Operating & Management System (80% Production-Ready)
description: A cutting-edge, desktop-native Library Operating and Management System built to replace clunky web portals and legacy library software. Provides a lightning-fast interface to manage cataloging, POS circulation with auto-fines, member KYC, donor registry, staff roster, payroll, expenses, and loan policy settings on macOS and Windows.

keyFeatures.title: Real-Time Command Dashboard
keyFeatures.description: Central command center displaying active member counts, total books, overdue loans, and quick action buttons.

keyFeatures.title: POS Circulation Desk
keyFeatures.description: Issue books via Member Code & Barcode, process returns, and calculate overdue fines ($0.50/day default rate).

keyFeatures.title: Inventory Catalog
keyFeatures.description: Full inventory management with multi-author/ISBN tracking and auto-generated sequential barcodes (e.g. BK-001).

keyFeatures.title: Patron Directory & KYC
keyFeatures.description: Register patrons with auto-generated Member IDs (MBR-TIMESTAMP) and colored active vs. expired status badges.

keyFeatures.title: Donors & Gift Registry
keyFeatures.description: Dual-tab system to register philanthropic Donors and track their specific book or monetary donations over time.

keyFeatures.title: Staff & Roster Directory
keyFeatures.description: Employee management module to track library staff, maintain contact info, and monitor active staff status.

keyFeatures.title: Automated Payroll Engine
keyFeatures.description: Generate dynamic payslips with net pay calculation (Base + Bonus - Deductions) and monthly payment tracking.

keyFeatures.title: Expenses & Financial Tracking
keyFeatures.description: Track daily operational expenses (utilities, maintenance, supplies) with monthly/yearly summary progress bars.

keyFeatures.title: Settings & Policy Reports
keyFeatures.description: Configure library name & address, adjust loan policies (days, fine rates), and view visual book popularity bars.

documentationSections.title: Part 1: Installation
documentationSections.content: Installing native binaries on macOS (.dmg) or Windows (.exe) operating systems.
steps: Download ShelfMaster.dmg for Mac or ShelfMaster-Setup.exe for Windows.
Run the installer executable or drag to Applications folder.
Activate using your 16-character Lemon Squeezy License Key.

documentationSections.title: Part 2: Setting Up Your Library
documentationSections.content: Configuring Library name, address, and global loan policy fine rates.
steps: Navigate to Settings in bottom left sidebar.
Enter your Library Name and Address.
Set standard loan duration (e.g. 14 days) and overdue fine rate (e.g. $0.50/day).

documentationSections.title: Part 3: Adding Books & Members
documentationSections.content: Cataloging book inventory and registering patrons with auto-generated IDs.
steps: In Catalog tab, click '+ Add Book' to auto-generate unique barcodes (BK-001).
In Members tab, click '+ Add Member' to generate Member IDs (MBR-TIMESTAMP).

documentationSections.title: Part 4: POS Circulation
documentationSections.content: Executing checkouts, returns, and automated overdue fine calculations.
steps: In Circulation tab, click 'Issue Book' and type Member ID + Book Barcode.
When returning, select from Active Loans and click Return.
ShelfMaster automatically calculates and displays overdue fines if late!
